figures.title: 今日图表（彭博 Aug 25）— 美国财政部的现金余额超过9000亿美元
figures.analysis: 彭博「今日图表」标题：美国财政部的现金余额超过9000亿美元。副题：CNBC报道称，财政部或动用现金储备为国债回购提供资金。橙线为美国财政部现金余额（TGA），2026年5月至8月：5月略低于1万亿美元，6月波动，7月初跌至约7300亿美元，8月回升至9000亿美元上方。来源标注美国财政部。这是TGA回购的流动性图，不是当日美股收盘；与市场一览「美债收益率小幅回落」和「金价升至逾三个月高点」一起读——财政干预与美元信用是同一本书。

marketTone: Monday was a Treasury-and-Iran morning, not a chip recovery. Bessent unveiled Operation Economic Outcast while CNBC reported the Treasury may fund buybacks from a ~$950bn cash account. The S&P 500 fell 0.28% and Nvidia extended a seven-day drop. Yields eased on the TGA report but gold hit a three-month high and copper a record. Trump threatened 50% Canadian auto tariffs from 2027 and Washington is planning a 7.5% China overcapacity levy before Xi’s visit.

summary.text: Monday’s US close (CNBC): S&P 500 7,652.86 (−0.28%); Nasdaq 25,980.19 (−0.76%); Dow 53,417.16 (+0.26% / +140.15). Micron −5.8%; the iShares Semiconductor ETF −2.7%. The 10-year yield fell more than 3 bp to 4.704% and the 30-year shed more than 4 bp to 5.234% after CNBC reported the Treasury may use the General Account to fund buybacks.

CNBC: Treasury Secretary Bessent has built the TGA to ~$950bn. Two senior officials said the account could fund enhanced long-end buybacks (≥$4bn from 9 September) without ruling out short-bill issuance. 见闻: gold $4651.24 (+1.05%); Brent $92.17 (−2.35%); bitcoin ~$78966 (+1.59%).

Bessent launched Operation Economic Outcast: secondary sanctions on Iran enablers; ~60 Iran-linked entities designated including dozens from mainland China and Hong Kong. China is not exempt. Traders said Iran oil exports to Asia had nearly stopped before the plan (desk/CLAIM).

CNBC: Trump said the US will raise tariffs on all Canadian cars, trucks, auto parts and steel to 50% from 1 January 2027. AP: Trump is considering a +7.5% Section 301 tariff on China before the late-September summit.

财新: PDD Q2 revenue 1123.58亿元 missed consensus; profit beat. 见闻: Alibaba closed its HK$80bn placing; PBOC rolled CNY500bn MLF with a CNY100bn net withdrawal; Xiaomi launched three Xuanjie chips. 第一财经: fiscal policy may shift up a gear in H2.

signal: The new tape is TGA buybacks and Iran isolation, not Friday’s bounce. Bessent may spend ~$950bn of cash on long-end repurchases while launching secondary sanctions that name China-linked entities. Yields fell on the TGA leak but gold and copper rallied on fiscal credibility, not duration. Nvidia’s seven-day drop is the equity book. Trump’s 50% Canada auto tariff and the 7.5% China levy are the trade book into Jackson Hole and Xi’s visit.
watch: Wednesday US PCE and Nvidia after the close · Jackson Hole Thursday–Friday; Warsh Friday · Alibaba placing close 26 August · first ≥$4bn buyback 9 September · Iran isolation timelines and oil flows · Canada retaliation 8 September · NPC Standing Committee through 28 August.

themeCards.title: Bessent may spend ~$950bn of TGA cash on long-end Treasury buybacks
themeCards.fact: CNBC: Treasury may use the ~$950bn General Account to fund enhanced buybacks (≥$4bn from 9 September). Monday the 10-year fell to 4.704% and the 30-year to 5.234%. 财经早茶 今日图表: TGA cash balance exceeded $900bn (Treasury line on the PNG). 市场一览: gold at a three-month high and LME copper at a record as fiscal intervention raised dollar-credibility concerns (desk/CLAIM). 见闻: gold $4651.24 (+1.05%).
themeCards.mechanism: Using tax cash already at the Fed to buy long bonds is a fiscal twist, not QE. Yields can fall for a session while gold and copper rise if the market prices debasement over duration. CICC CLAIM (24 August): the buyback fade is term premium; the dollar is the damaged asset. Keep Iran oil on its own card.
themeCards.trigger: A dated TGA deployment size before the 9 September operation, or a session where gold falls with the 30-year yield.
themeCards.invalidator: Officials rule out TGA use and yields stay elevated with gold flat.

themeCards.title: Bessent launched Operation Economic Outcast against Iran’s enablers
themeCards.fact: CNBC: Bessent unveiled secondary sanctions on Iran enablers; China is not exempt. 财经早茶 国际要闻: Treasury sanctioned ~60 Iran-linked entities including dozens from mainland China and Hong Kong; Iran oil exports to Asia had nearly stopped before the plan and cargo prices hit multi-year highs (desk/CLAIM). 市场一览: oil fell as traders weighed the isolation plan. 见闻: Brent $92.17 (−2.35%).
themeCards.mechanism: This is a geopolitics book that can lift oil even when Treasury is buying long bonds. Secondary sanctions on China-linked entities add Asia equity risk. Do not fold Monday’s oil drop into the TGA card — the desk is weighing execution, not peace.
themeCards.trigger: A dated country timeline, a confirmed flow shutdown, or Brent back above $95 on new isolation steps.
themeCards.invalidator: No new designations and oil flat with Iran exports resuming.

themeCards.title: The S&P 500 fell and Nvidia extended a seven-day losing streak
themeCards.fact: CNBC: S&P 500 7,652.86 (−0.28%); Nasdaq 25,980.19 (−0.76%); Dow 53,417.16 (+0.26%). Micron −5.8%; SOXX −2.7%. 财经早茶 市场一览: chip stocks sold off again and Nvidia logged a seven-day decline (desk/CLAIM). 见闻: Philadelphia semiconductor index down nearly 4%; Nvidia reports Wednesday after the close.
themeCards.mechanism: This is the AI-hardware beta book into Wednesday’s Nvidia print. Memory-cost pass-through and server-price hikes are a margin story, not the same as Iran oil or TGA buybacks. Asia semis can lag even if the Dow holds up on defensives.
themeCards.trigger: Nvidia’s Wednesday earnings, or a dated memory-price move that walks back the 15%+ server hike.
themeCards.invalidator: NVDA reclaims the seven-day drop with SOXX up and yields stable.

themeCards.title: Trump will raise Canadian auto and steel tariffs to 50% from 2027
themeCards.fact: CNBC: Trump said the US will raise tariffs on all Canadian cars, trucks, auto parts and steel to 50% from 1 January 2027 (from 25%). 财经早茶 国际要闻: the US–Canada trade dispute escalated further (desk/CLAIM). 市场一览: the Canadian dollar was the weakest G10 currency as the trade fight worsened (desk/CLAIM).
themeCards.mechanism: This is a 2027 auto-tariff book layered on Saturday’s 50% goods duties. Read it as North American supply-chain risk and CAD beta, not as the TGA or Iran tape. Canada’s 8 September retaliation list is the nearer trigger.
themeCards.trigger: Canada’s 8 September retaliation list, or a dated restart of talks.
themeCards.invalidator: Duties walked back with no new auto list.

themeCards.title: Washington may add a 7.5% China overcapacity tariff before Xi’s visit
themeCards.fact: AP sources: Trump is considering a +7.5% Section 301 tariff on Chinese goods for industrial overcapacity before the late-September Trump–Xi summit. 财经早茶 国际要闻: the same desk/CLAIM ahead of Xi’s September US visit.
themeCards.mechanism: This is a summit leverage book, not a PBOC liquidity print. It hits ADRs and exporters while Iran secondary sanctions already name China-linked entities. Do not read Alibaba’s closed placing as tariff relief.
themeCards.trigger: A dated USTR notice, or a summit delay that removes the September deadline.
themeCards.invalidator: Truce extended with no new Section 301 layer.

themeCards.title: PBOC net-withdrew MLF liquidity while PDD and XPeng missed on revenue
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶 大中华: PBOC rolled CNY500bn one-year MLF with a CNY100bn net withdrawal and flagged overnight reverse-repo ops at month-end (desk/CLAIM). 财新: PDD Q2 revenue 1123.58亿元 missed consensus; XPeng Q2 revenue and Q3 guide missed. 见闻: Alibaba closed HK$80bn placing; Cai and Wu bought Wu bought HK$120mn of stock; Xiaomi launched three Xuanjie chips. 第一财经: fiscal policy may shift up a gear in H2.
themeCards.mechanism: MLF net withdrawal is not easing even as People’s Daily said not to obsess over one quarter’s data. PDD and XPeng revenue misses are a consumption and EV book separate from the chip selloff. Hang Seng can move on Alibaba’s placing while CSI waits for August NBS demand.
themeCards.trigger: August NBS retail and FAI, or a dated incremental fiscal package with a yuan size.
themeCards.invalidator: MLF net injection plus August demand beats with no new tariff.
